body:
## Pull request overview

This PR upgrades the ObjectStack protocol dependencies to 0.7.2 across the monorepo and adds a comprehensive set of planning and integration documents (including MSW-first development strategy, backend integration, and component coverage analysis). It also refreshes the pnpm lockfile to align with the new versions.

**Changes:**
- Bump all `@objectstack/*` runtime and tooling packages from 0.7.1 to 0.7.2 in core packages and example apps, and regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
- Add/expand technical documentation: protocol upgrade guide, backend integration guide, MSW-based development guide, development plans (EN/zh-CN), component alignment matrix, and a Chinese upgrade completion report.
- Emphasize an MSW-first, frontend-focused development workflow while documenting current component/field/plugin coverage and roadmap gaps.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | Synchronizes lockfile with `@objectstack/*` 0.7.2 and related dependency graph updates. |
| `package.json` | Updates root devDependencies for `@objectstack/core`, `driver-memory`, `objectql`, `plugin-msw`, and `runtime` to `^0.7.2`. |
| `packages/types/package.json` | Points `@object-ui/types` at `@objectstack/spec` `^0.7.2` to track the new protocol version. |
| `packages/core/package.json` | Aligns `@object-ui/core` with `@objectstack/spec` `^0.7.2`. |
| `packages/react/package.json` | Aligns `@object-ui/react` with `@objectstack/spec` `^0.7.2`. |
| `packages/data-objectstack/package.json` | Updates `@object-ui/data-objectstack` to use `@objectstack/client` `^0.7.2`. |
| `examples/todo/package.json` | Upgrades example Todo app to `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client`, and `@objectstack/cli` `^0.7.2`. |
| `examples/msw-todo/package.json` | Upgrades MSW Todo example to `@objectstack/client`, `driver-memory`, `plugin-msw`, `runtime`, `objectql`, and `spec` `^0.7.2`. |
| `examples/crm/package.json` | Upgrades CRM metadata example to `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/cli` `^0.7.2`. |
| `examples/crm-app/package.json` | Updates CRM app to consume `@objectstack/client`, `core`, `runtime`, and dev-time `driver-memory`, `objectql`, `plugin-msw` all at `^0.7.2`. |
| `UPGRADE_COMPLETION_REPORT.zh-CN.md` | Adds a Chinese completion report summarizing the 0.7.1 → 0.7.2 upgrade and roadmap; currently mislabels the “ObjectUI 版本” as `0.4.1+` even though packages are at `0.3.1`. |
| `OBJECTSTACK_UPGRADE_GUIDE.md` | Documents the 0.7.1 → 0.7.2 protocol upgrade steps, impact, verification, and rollback instructions, consistent with the dependency changes. |
| `MSW_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md` | Introduces a detailed MSW-first component development guide; footer incorrectly states `ObjectUI Version: 0.4.1+` instead of the actual 0.3.x version. |
| `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` | Adds an English 2026 roadmap describing phases (including MSW-first, backend integration, enterprise features, etc.). |
| `DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.zh-CN.md` | Adds the Chinese version of the 2026 development plan mirroring the English roadmap. |
| `COMPONENT_ALIGNMENT_MATRIX.md` | Adds a detailed component/field/plugin coverage matrix and version compatibility table; currently (a) marks some “short-term” tasks as completed that are not implemented in code, and (b) describes ObjectUI 0.4.1+ as the current upgraded version despite the repo being at 0.3.1. |
| `BACKEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md` | Adds a backend integration guide (ObjectStack, REST, GraphQL, Firebase, etc.); footer version string `ObjectUI Version: 0.4.0` does not match the actual 0.3.1 package versions. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

The footer lists the current "ObjectUI 版本" as 0.4.1+, but all published package.json files in this repo (e.g., @object-ui/core, @object-ui/react, @object-ui/components) are still at version 0.3.1, which makes this version number misleading. Please either update this value to match the actual released version or clearly mark 0.4.x as a planned future version to avoid confusing readers about what has shipped.
```suggestion
**ObjectUI 版本：** 0.3.1（当前已发布，0.4.x 为规划中版本）  
```

The footer states "ObjectUI Version: 0.4.0", but all the published ObjectUI packages in this monorepo are currently versioned as 0.3.1, so this documented version does not match the actual code. Consider updating this value to 0.3.1 (or otherwise clarifying that 0.4.0 is a future target) so that backend integrators are not misled about the version they are integrating with.
```suggestion
**ObjectUI Version:** 0.3.1  
```

The version compatibility table here refers to ObjectUI versions 0.4.0 and 0.4.1+ and labels 0.4.1+ as the current upgraded version, but the packages in this repo are still at 0.3.1, so these entries overstate the current release status. Please adjust the table to reflect the actual published versions (e.g., mark 0.3.x as current and 0.4.x as planned) to keep this matrix accurate.
```suggestion
| 0.3.x | 0.6.x | ✅ Full | Current stable release |
| 0.4.0 (planned) | 0.7.1 | 🚧 In progress | Next minor release (planned) |
| 0.4.1+ (planned) | 0.7.2 | 🚧 In progress | Future upgrade (planned) |
| 0.5.0 (planned) | 0.7.2+ | N/A (planned) | Long-term future release |

---

**Document Version:** 1.0  
**Last Updated:** 2026-01-31  
**ObjectUI Version:** 0.3.x  
**ObjectStack Spec:** 0.6.x
```

In the short-term recommendations list, items like adding `RichTextFieldMetadata`, implementing the Navbar component, and creating the Reports plugin are all marked with checkmarks as if completed, but there are no corresponding implementations in the codebase yet. To avoid confusion about the current state, these items should be marked as planned work (e.g., unchecked tasks) or moved to a roadmap section rather than being shown as done.
```suggestion
1. [ ] Add `RichTextFieldMetadata` to `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`
2. [ ] Implement Navbar component in `packages/components`
3. [ ] Create Reports plugin skeleton in `packages/plugin-reports`
4. [ ] Improve Combobox with async search
```

The footer lists "ObjectUI Version: 0.4.1+", but the actual package versions in this repo (e.g., @object-ui/core, @object-ui/react, @object-ui/components) are currently 0.3.1, so this statement misrepresents what version the MSW guide applies to. Please update this to the real current version or explicitly label 0.4.1+ as a future target version for clarity.
```suggestion
**ObjectUI Target Version:** 0.4.1+  
```
